detail: PMID 36224396. No interval, so no standard error. The multi-ancestry score PGS002802 has European R² 0.399 and 0.401; its other ancestries run from 0.094 to 0.214. Ancestry-specific scores in the same set go down to 0.033. These scores have about a million variants, not the 12,111-variant predictor cited by the reviewer.

clause: Yengo 2022 height evaluations with an interval
detail: Zero intervals. Yengo height cannot be meta-analyzed from the Catalog.

clause: Named PGS R2 (no covariates) with an interval
detail: This field is the unadjusted PGS R². It is not an R² attached to an AUROC row.

clause: Those evaluations that also have an AUROC
detail: The named PGS R² interval does not sit on the manuscript's AUROC evaluations.

clause: Score-trait pairs with a named PGS R2 interval and both ancestries
detail: Each pair is one score in one trait, with a European evaluation and a non-European evaluation. 586 of 608 traits have one score; 22 traits appear in both papers. See 17_r2_scores_per_trait.csv.
570 of these pairs label one European sample as a UK Biobank held-out testing cohort. The other European sample is a second UK Biobank partition.
UK Biobank. One score per trait in this paper.

clause: Incremental R2 intervals on the named-PGS-R2 evaluations
detail: The covariate-adjusted PGS contribution has no interval, so it has no standard error.

clause: Full-model R2 intervals on the named-PGS-R2 evaluations
detail: The full-model R² includes the covariates. Its interval is not a PGS-only interval.

clause: Named PGS R2 reported with no interval
detail: All 1189 are Tanigawa 2022. 1189 note Nagelkerke's R². 1189 put the interval on PGS AUROC rather than on the R².

clause: Traits with more than one score inside one paper
detail: Within a paper the maximum number of scores in one trait is 1. There is no second score to pool.

clause: Other publications with a different R2 interval and both ancestries
detail: Largest other set: Monti R 2024 (PMID 38908374), 177 score–trait pairs, up to 13 scores in one trait. Of the Monti et al. 2024 pairs, 68 are quantitative (the note says the beta is a Pearson correlation) and the covariates field is 0. See 17_r2_cross_ancestry_papers.csv.
